title: Temporary VTS hold and subsequent release

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is Harbour VTS. INSTRUCTION. Do not enter the fairway. Remain in the designated holding area west and south of the entrance and await further instructions. OUTBOUND traffic is departing. Over.
events.expected_response: Acknowledge the restriction and stop or otherwise hold south of the y equals minus one thousand metre entry boundary without creating a new collision risk.

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is Harbour VTS. INFORMATION. OUTBOUND traffic has cleared the fairway. INSTRUCTION. You may proceed inbound. Over.
events.expected_response: Acknowledge the release, reassess the observed traffic, resume when safe, enter the fairway, and complete the passage.
